note: Golden expectations for src/verdict.rs on the Harness A/B pair 1.8.44 -> 1.8.50 (5 runs per arm, only the Harness changes). States, not p-values: any reproduction of the rule (Release Control) must reach the same states with the default rule and reproduce the PRNG vectors exactly. `first` holds u64 values as decimal strings.

calibration.note: A version against itself: both arms drawn with replacement, test by test, from one arm's counted runs (the arms in turn; SplitMix64 from `seed`, one generator over every draw, index = next() % runs), `runs_per_arm` runs per test on each; better, worse or a qualifier count as a false signal. Each trial's rule has `permutations` (fewer than the default, to keep the test fast; a permutation p counting the observed round is valid at any count) and seed = the trial's index.
